items.headline: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
TVS Supply Chain Solutions shares jump 17% after Q2 results, surge 24% in 2 weeks; what lies ahead? Key levels to watch
items.summary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions shares surged 17% after Q2 FY27 revenue rose 38% year on year to ₹3,687.2 crore and net profit more than doubled to ₹36.5 crore. The company cited broad-based growth, operational improvements and strong new-business wins.
